Pyridoxine/vitamin B6
25–1800 mg
Improve immune system; improve glucose
tolerance; reduce homocysteine levels; treat 
artherosclerosis; reduce cervical cancer risk;

High doses may reduce folate levels; can interfere

9–100 mg
